messages:
noah: Dropping a compact roles-matrix iteration. Goals: reduce vertical density, make SSO status obvious, and add a fast audit-log jump to related invites. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/roles-matrix-compact-2026.png noah: Changes: compact rows (10px gap), role chips inline, visibility selector (All / SSO-required / Pending) top-left, and a tiny SSO badge next to user avatars. diane: Love the avatar-badge idea. Q: should the visibility selector persist per user? customers asked for that in support tickets. noah: Yeah plan is per-user persistence in localStorage initially. We'll evaluate a server-side preference later. marcus: Minor UX nit: on 1366x768 the role names are getting cramped. Instead of ellipsizing after one line, allow two-line wrap with a max-height and fade gradient. Also tighten left padding by 8px. claire: For the invite drawer, prefer an inline helper below the email input instead of a top banner when SSO is required. Example copy: "SSO required for this org. Invited users will sign in with your SSO provider. Learn more." rob: Also add inline pre-submit validation: if invited email doesn't match allowed domains, show a soft warning (muted red) with helper text and a small 'override' control for admins. Some customers want to block by default, others want to allow contractors. noah: Adding an admin setting mock: "Allow external invites when SSO is required" with description. Default: allow with soft warning. accessibility-bot: Accessibility check: tooltips and helper text must be keyboard-focusable and announced. aria-live="polite" on validation, aria-describedby linking from input to helper. Contrast warning: current amber badge (#f2a84b) fails AA on 12px. Suggest #c76a18 or darker. claire: Sample pattern for validation we can use: ```
SSO required. Invited users will join via SSO.
``` noah: thanks — that's what i'll wire into the prototype. marcus: Audit log: proposal: add a compact "Related" mini panel in event detail (right rail) with quick links: "Invites (3)", "Role changes (2)", "SSO events (5)". Clicking expands inline so you don't navigate away. Small counts and timestamps. diane: Nice. Also add a keyboard shortcut to open the visibility selector (press `f`) and cycle options with arrows. Power users will like it. rob: UX copy nit for the SSO badge tooltip: change to "SSO required — user must sign in with your SSO provider to access this org." Keep it short. noah: i'll update tooltip copy + make sure it's reachable by keyboard and screen readers. For the SSO badge we'll use aria-label=\"SSO required\" and tabindex=\"0\" for focus. accessibility-bot: QA checklist for devs: 1) chip and badge keyboard focusable + aria-label, 2) invite validation uses aria-live polite, 3) helper text elements linked via aria-describedby, 4) color contrast >=4.5 for small text, 5) two-line wrap allowed for role names at common breakpoints. claire: I'll put together a short accessibility test doc for the QA pass. noah: I'll drop an interactive prototype and a 45s demo clip later today, plus a PR with the color updates and keyboard shortcuts. Thanks all :rocket: marcus: Excited to try it. diane: Ping me on the PR for the persistence bits. noah: (thread closed)
